name: mcp-qdrant
description: MCP server that wraps the Qdrant vector database API as tools.

qdrant_url.title: Qdrant URL
qdrant_url.description: e.g. http://localhost:6333 — leave blank if using a local path instead.

qdrant_api_key.title: Qdrant API key
qdrant_api_key.description: Only needed if your Qdrant instance requires one.

qdrant_local_path.title: Qdrant local path
qdrant_local_path.description: Path to an embedded Qdrant instance, instead of a URL.

toolsets.title: Enabled toolsets
toolsets.description: Comma-separated: core, search, payload, snapshots, observability.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Block every tool not marked read-only.
